# Owned synthetic static trigger pattern fixture

This directory contains one deterministic, architecture-neutral pattern-IR
fixture for Phase 10D Step 8B-2D3-A. It is explicitly owned, synthetic and
benign.

The pattern describes two address-independent AArch64 semantic program-order
cases designed for a future 2D3-B contract test. It stores no fused graph ID,
function/block/instruction address, CFG edge, candidate witness or expected
matcher result.

This fixture is not a real hardware vulnerability, not a real hardware
trigger, not runtime evidence and not a verified attack chain. Pattern
definition does not establish a firmware match, runtime execution,
triggerability, causality or vulnerability verification.
